verdict.rationale: The evidence shows jo runs a native macOS app and operates its own cloud machine and browser, plus API integrations such as Linear and GitHub. Nothing documents jo seeing the user's screen or operating applications on the user's own computer. Its own browser and cloud machine are an adjacent capability, not computer-use on the user's device.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
